name: SMA Crossover Strategy - USD/JPY
description: 50/200 SMA crossover strategy on USD/JPY daily bars. Goes long when the 50-day SMA crosses above the 200-day SMA, and short when it crosses below. Always in the market (long or short) with 100% capital allocation.
source:
# SMA Crossover Strategy - EUR/USD
# 50/200 SMA crossover on daily bars
# Long when fast SMA > slow SMA, Short when fast SMA < slow SMA
# Always in the market (long or short), 100% capital allocation

# Daily price data
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Fast (50-day) and Slow (200-day) SMA
fast_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Trend signal: bullish when fast > slow, bearish when fast < slow
is_bullish = fast_sma > slow_sma
is_bearish = fast_sma < slow_sma

# Hold long/short state between crossover events
long_state = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)
short_state = hold_until()(enter=is_bearish, exit=is_bullish)

# Execution - always in market, long or short
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_state, short_entry=short_state)

# 100% of capital allocated to the single position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
